title: Fine-Tuning-Free Latent Steering as a Lightweight Defense Variation

original_idea.body: Add a scaled refusal direction at inference and sweep the coefficient to find whether it hardens against prefill attacks without breaking helpfulness (XSTest).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: No-training defense alternative directly responsive to an Open Phil RFP open problem; defensible robustness chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Difference-of-means refusal direction + coefficient sweep + XSTest; public methods, beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: sweep coefficient, measure attack success vs over-refusal.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: No-training single-GPU defense, public model, no internal access; addresses RFP open problem.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only steering on one model; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Inference-time refusal-direction steering as a defense is fairly established (Arditi, AlphaSteer); largely addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Inference-time refusal-direction steering as a lightweight defense is fairly established; the over-refusal-tradeoff angle adds a little.
